strings: Dear Sir/Madam,          On behalf of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of the Union of Myanmar, we would like to request room reservations at Pan Pacific Yangon for an upcoming official delegation.We kindly ask you to confirm the availability of suitable rooms for the delegation during the intended stay period. Guest passport details and relevant information will be shared as an attachment for your reference.
Your assistance in facilitating this arrangement will be highly appreciated.
Prepared by: Secretary, Cabinet Adviser Committee
Quorum: Achieved (9 out of 11 members present)
Present: Chief Strategy Adviser, Cabinet Representative from the Prime Minister

s Office, External Adviser on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation, Internal Adviser on Finance and Operations, External Adviser on Sustainability and ESG, Cabinet Representative from the Project Planning Division, Adviser on Global Markets, Adviser on Legal and Compliance, and Adviser on Talent and Organizational Development.
Absent: Adviser on Supply Chain Management and Adviser on Innovation (both with prior intimation).
Call to Order and Welcome Remarks
Approval of Minutes of the Previous Meeting held on February 15, 2026
Update on Strategic Planning for Q2 2026
Adviser Recommendations on AI Governance Framework
Review of Budget Allocation for 2026 Initiatives
Item 1: Approval of Previous Meeting Minutes
The minutes of the Cabinet (Adviser Committee) Meeting held on February 15, 2026 were reviewed in detail and approved unanimously without any amendments.
Item 2: Strategic Planning Update for Q2 2026

The Cabinet Representative provided a detailed update on the implementation status of the 2026 strategic plan. Key progress includes a 15% increase in pipeline projects in the Asia-Pacific region, supporting enhanced regional cooperation and export promotion under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative. Members emphasized alignment with self-reliant growth and raised concerns over supply chain volatility due to geopolitical developments, calling for robust risk mitigation strategies.
Item 3: Adviser Recommendations on AI Governance Framework

The Advisers presented a comprehensive draft AI Governance Framework focusing on ethical AI deployment, data privacy, talent upskilling, and responsible innovation. Emphasis was placed on alignment with the IndiaAI Mission, Digital India programme, and safeguarding national data sovereignty while harmonizing with global standards.
Item 4: Budget Allocation Review for 2026 Initiatives
of the Union Budget 2026-27 on climate resilience, green growth, and technology-led development.
Item 5: New Business and Open Discussion

The External Adviser on Sustainability proposed establishing a cross-functional Sustainability Task Force to mainstream ESG principles. The proposal received strong support, aligning with national climate action and sustainable development goals.
The revised AI Governance Framework was approved in principle, with minor amendments to the implementation timeline to ensure alignment with the IndiaAI Mission.
Reallocation of USD 984,000 (12% of operations budget) to ESG and sustainability projects for Q2 2026 was approved.
Constitution of a cross-functional Sustainability Task Force under the Sustainability Adviser was approved.
Acceleration of the Asia-Pacific market expansion plan with enhanced risk monitoring, consistent with Atmanirbhar Bharat and India
Finalize and circulate the updated AI Governance Framework
Prepare detailed risk mitigation plan for Q2 strategy
Develop charter and membership for the Sustainability Task Force
Update 2026 budget spreadsheet with approved reallocations

Venue: Hybrid (Conference Room A + Video Conferencing)
Agenda to include: Progress review of action items and Q3 strategy preview with focus on IndiaAI Mission.

The meeting was productive and collaborative, advancing national priorities in AI governance, sustainable development, and self-reliant growth. The Cabinet Adviser Committee continues to provide valuable evidence-based advice for effective policy implementation. All action items will be monitored and reported in the next meeting.
The Cabinet places on record its appreciation for the contributions of the Adviser Committee members.
